findings.description: Resolved on 4d128eb9. createOrReplaceSymlink now builds the link at a unique temp name (pid+time+random) and renames it over linkPath (POSIX-atomic, last-writer-wins); on rename failure the temp link is removed and the error rethrown, so a real directory at linkPath is never deleted. Sealed r2-g1 witnesses W-r15-unlink-enoent, W-r15-symlink-eexist, B-r15-dangling, W-r15-promise-all-x30, I-r15-postcopyops-x30 and controls C-r15-* pass on the head (symlink-race.test.ts 8/8). Independent cross-process probe of the same fs call sequence: 3 node processes x 300 replacements on one project: 900/900 ok, 0 EEXIST/ENOENT, final .github/skills -> ../.claude/skills, no leftover temp link.
findings.recommendation: None. VERIFY: symlink-race.test.ts + 3-process x300 probe; ORACLE: AC9; ASSERT: 0 rejections (observed).
